reviewedIdentity.verification: Independently recomputed every final source-manifest hash and all 31 capture hashes; decoded image dimensions agree with the corrected capture manifest. No mismatches.

fulfillmentAndVisualDesign.assessment: The written ivory/carbon/bronze anchors are consistently expressed across architecture, equipment, hardware, screens and interface surfaces. The light architecture remains clearly separate from dark equipment, bronze stays restrained, and natural/media/solar/sky exceptions retain visual sense. The reference images informed color relationships without importing their geometry or framing differences.

ReadabilityAndInteractionStates.assessment: Carbon/ivory text and accessible bronze derivatives are used on the intended surfaces. Source review found and resolved low-contrast selected-category text/counts, weak studio selection borders and inherited focus-ring aliases. Final screenshots and computed/pixel samples support readable normal, focused, selected, disabled and validation states. Sampling remains representative rather than exhaustive across every pose, hover/press moment or owner-authored asset.

correctnessAndScopePreservation.assessment: The diff is limited to colors, color assignment, corresponding tests and decision/evidence records. Scene geometry, object placement, camera/navigation, light rig, exposure, roughness/metalness and animation timing remain unchanged. The old saturation transform is removed. Legacy default accents resolve at presentation time without rewriting persisted content; nondefault owner accents remain supported. No held performance proposal or backend/authentication behavior was introduced.

evidenceAndVerification.assessment: Evidence includes source/capture identities, all cabins and overview at both viewports, representative readers/tools/forms/studio states, rendered contrast samples and isolated test records. All 512 distinct tests have passing partition coverage, with final typecheck/build/affected Oxlint and the focused iris rerun passing. Failed fixture attempts and later CSS/test revisions are preserved and explained. Ladder close-ups use a finite fixture, browser coverage is Chromium only, and contrast sampling is bounded.

maintainabilityAndDecisionRecords.assessment: Shared TypeScript/CSS semantic tokens replace scattered authored colors. AGENTS.md, PROJECT-CONTEXT.md and OPERATIONS.md distinguish the current palette from superseded amber treatments and explain exceptions, metadata handling and focus states. Evidence accurately distinguishes live captures from static fixtures and partitioned checks from an uninterrupted green suite.

reviewMethod.source: Read the request, AGENTS.md, PROJECT-CONTEXT.md, current Git diff, shared palette/material implementation, affected room/equipment/canvas/UI styles, tests and final evidence records. Audited remaining hard-coded colors and retained transformations. A separate PostCSS declaration comparison found no non-color CSS changes except removal of the former brightness filter; final opacity adjustments are color/readability changes.
reviewMethod.visual: Independently opened and inspected all 31 final capture subjects, including refreshed captures. Reviewed overview and all four cabins at landscape and portrait sizes; physical focus, mounted notebook, project application and reading view, contact fields/validation, Tools/playback/diagnostics, studio fields/selection/dialog/error/save/disabled controls, and the three finite ladder views. The critic inspected supplied captures rather than driving a separate browser session.
reviewMethod.checks: Inspected source-identified check logs and summaries rather than rerunning mutation-bearing tests. Independently checked final source/capture hashes, decoded dimensions, static color-pair sanity, and git diff --check.

resolvedFindings.finding: The root --ring alias could retain the light focus color when --focus-color changed in a light studio/reader scope.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Rebound --ring in the relevant surface scopes; final field and reader-focus captures show the appropriate dark/light indicator.

resolvedFindings.finding: Selected studio records and editor sections relied on weak ivory/alloy borders.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Used dark-bronze selection borders and verified selected records, tabs and category controls in the final studio captures.

resolvedFindings.finding: Reading-view Projects selected categories used dark bronze on a dark surface, and category counts in both reading libraries retained reducing opacity.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Selected text follows the accessible surface accent; functional counts are opaque. The final selected-category sample measures approximately 7.16:1 after compositing.

resolvedFindings.finding: Early overview, immersive focus and saved-studio captures were stale, transitional or incomplete.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Refreshed the affected captures. The final immersive focused Live action uses carbon text on ivory; the studio save-action region and portrait contact fields are fully rendered.

resolvedFindings.finding: The first capture inventory misread JPEG bytes as PNG headers and reported impossible dimensions; the README also named ESLint although the actual command uses Oxlint.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Regenerated metadata with a decoder, converted the browser JPEG captures to genuine PNG without resizing or decoded-pixel color edits, recorded original encoding and final hashes, and corrected the lint name. Independently revalidated all 31 dimensions and hashes.

independentRenderedSanitySamples.method: Representative glyph-interior luminance percentile versus nearby median unprinted background, measured from the actual screenshot pixels. These independent estimates corroborate readability after scene lighting/dimming; they are not minima over all antialiased edges or WCAG certification.

limitations: Hidden built-in Chromium was the browser tested; native Safari/iOS were not controlled or tested.

Ladder detail captures use static fixture lighting/cameras without GTAO, sky, persisted content or runtime dimming/navigation. Production overview captures supplement them; they are not live ladder-flight evidence.

Browser screenshots originated as JPEG and therefore retain that capture's compression characteristics after lossless decoding to PNG. Contrast reports are representative local estimates, not certification for every text edge, camera pose or uploaded asset.

All 512 distinct tests passed in documented partitions after fixture recovery, not in one uninterrupted all-green npm test run. The three later CSS corrections and final iris comparator rerun are source-identified.
No steady-state performance, thermal, battery or native Safari improvement was measured or claimed.
